chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, Allah the Exalted did not grant Satan authority over the believers except in four places.
The first is when angry, the second is when sleeping, the third is when leaving the house, and the fourth is when supplicating.
ai.seo_question: What are the four times when Satan has authority over believers according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (AS) identifying four critical junctures—anger, sleep, exiting the home, and supplication—where Satan’s whispering (*waswasa*) is most potent. This narration underscores the Shia emphasis on *muraqabah* (mindfulness of God) as a defensive spiritual practice, highlighting that even acts of worship like du'a require vigilance against satanic interference to ensure sincerity and acceptance.
